shots.description: Golden-hour title screen: the start screen over the warm low-sun city, sun disc on the horizon, neon signs glowing.
Sunset chase story job: job 4 getaway in progress at dusk on a rain-slick neon street, dialogue open, HUD and minimap readable, wanted 2 stars, police in pursuit.
Night wanted-level pursuit race: race 3 Marina Bay Grand Tour at night, police helicopter searchlight visible, live standings showing the player leading, wanted 4 stars.
Pause screen with percent-complete and lifetime stats, framed over the dusk city.
